title: Intertwining of the Gysin-at-infinity class with the localized p-th Chern class under the further hypothesis that the rank of the quotient is less than p
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology and Chern Classes)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Building on the localized Chern class lemma, and adding the hypothesis that the restriction of Q to the complement T is finite locally free of rank less than p, the lemma asserts the two equalities C o c_p(Q|_{X x 0}) = C o (Z -> X)_* o c'_p(Q) = c_p(Q|_{W_infinity}) o C for the class C of the Gysin-at-infinity lemma (statement lines 10352-10362). The first equality is the preceding localized Chern class statement, and the second is reduced one cycle class at a time by the bivariant axiom, after assuming the construction compatible with base change; the author then verifies the identity by an explicit chain of eight displayed equalities inside A^*(X), each of which is justified separately: rewriting c'_p(Q) through its restriction to E, identifying the two routes E -> Z -> X and E -> W_infinity -> X, introducing beta with C cap alpha = i_infinity^* beta, using the key computation relating c'_p(Q|_E) to c_p(Q|_{W_infinity}) on i_infinity^* beta, and using twice that c_p(Q) is a bivariant class so that it commutes with i_infinity^* (proof lines 10365-10404). The bookkeeping that pairs each of the eight equalities with the exact lemma that justifies it, under the rank hypothesis, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
